title: Pumpkin Oatmeal Muffins with Greek Yogurt

Main: 1 (15-oz.) can pumpkin puree (not pumpkin pie filling)
¼ cup vegetable oil (or canola, avocado, or light olive oil)
½ tsp. ground nutmeg (plus optional ⅛ tsp. ground cloves)
For Serving: ½ cup raisins (or dark chocolate chips, dried cranberries)
½ cup chopped walnuts (or pecans, pumpkin seeds) for topping
Extra brown sugar for sprinkling on top

steps: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Lightly grease a 12-cup muffin pan or spray muffin liners with oil.
In a large bowl, whisk together pumpkin puree, Greek yogurt, brown sugar, vegetable oil, egg, and vanilla extract until smooth and well combined.
Add rolled oats, all-purpose flour, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg, and salt. Stir gently with a spoon until just combined — do not overmix.
If using raisins or chocolate chips, gently fold them in now.
Divide batter evenly among the 12 muffin cups. They will be quite full — that's fine.
Sprinkle chopped walnuts on top, along with a little extra brown sugar if you like.
Bake at 375°F (190°C) for about 25–28 minutes, until tops are set and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out with a few moist crumbs (not wet batter).
Let muffins cool in the pan for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely. They will firm up as they cool.
